text.body:
{ṣaṭcakranirṇaya}
[atha ṣaṭcakranirṇayoyaṃ likhyate ]||
oṃ ṣaṭcakraṃ ṣoḍaśādhāraṃ trilakṣyaṃ vyomapañcakam | śarīraṃ yena jānanti na te yogyāḥ kulāgame || 1 ||
ā (*)(?) brahmabilaṃ cakraṃ sandantateṣva(?)vasthitam | yoganālaṃ samutpannaṃ trailokye sa carācare || 3 ||
brahmakaṃndādhāraṃ brahmakaṃ sukhaṃ dadātīti brahmakāndam ||
anyaśāstrābhiprāyaḥ ||
nāḍi tritayamuddiṣṭaṃ yatra līyetasaṃjñitam | tacca kandeti paryāyaṃ tacca brahmabilaṃ smṛtam || 3 ||
vāmadakṣiṇake nāḍyā viḍāpiṅgalasaṃjñake |
(folio 193 is missing but this seems to be a numbering mistake)
tayormadhye sthitā nāḍī suṣumṇā madhyamā smṛtā || 4 ||
viśrutā brahmanāḍīti brahmadarśayatissphuṭam | tasya (*)(?) labilaṃ kandaṃ nābhyūrdhvādhoṅgulaṃ smṛtam || 5 ||
tattrikoṇamiti jñeyaṃ vistarādaṅguli trayam | tasya madhye sthitā śaktiḥ pañcakāraṇabhakṣiṇī || 6 ||
saṅkocana prayogena prabuddhā bhavatīti sā | bhāvānābhāvagamyā sāprayātā parame pade || 7 ||
evaṃ jñātvā mahābhāge kandādhāre sthitiṃ kuru | tatra sthitvātmano rūpaṃ prākṛtaṃ tu parityajet || 8 ||
grāhayed bhāvanā yātaṃ (*)(?) hātsarvagataṃ śivam | yaṃ prāpya tarate pāraṃ ghorāt saṃsārasāgarāt || 9 ||
dvitīyaṃ nābhicakraṃ tu nāgakuṇḍalasannibham | kuṇḍalīkṛti vikhyātamudayāstagakāraṇam || 10 ||
anyaśāstrābhiprāyaḥ ||
nābhimadhye sthitā śaktiḥ prasuptabhujagākṛtiḥ | phaṇapañcakasaṃyuktā vāmāvartā trivartulā || 11 ||
pañcāśaṃdvijajananī praṇavākhyā trivāhagā | ūrdhvādhaḥ kramayogena yā śivāntaṃ śivolvanā || 12 ||
prabuddhā cāṇu vajjñeya (**)(?) suptā kuṇḍalākṛtiḥ | tripañcāṅgulavistārāmitavarṇā kulāraṇī || 13 ||
tasya madhye yadā (**)(?) saṃsthito hyekamānasaḥ | nānāvidhāni cihnāni paśyati svapnavat priye || 14 ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena bodhayet kuṇḍalākṛtim | tṛtīyaṃ hṛdaye cakraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadvyāpakaṃ prabhum |
padmarāgasamākāramādityasamatejasam || 16 ||
tṛtrodāharaṇam ||
nābhe ūrdhvaṃ vitaśrātu kaṇṭhadūrdhvaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulam | hṛdayaṃ tad vijānīyād viśvasyāyatanaṃ mahat || 17 ||
hṛccakramadhye kamalaṃ ṣoḍaśārāṅgulairyutam | aṣṭāṅgulapramāṇena lambamānamadhomukham || 18 ||
karṇikākesarairyuktaṃ haṃsasya padameva hi | tatrābhyāsagato yogī paśyatyātmānamātmanā || 19 ||
caturthaṃ kaṇḍacakraṃ tu nāḍīsaṅghaṭṭagocaram | saṅghataṃ sarvanāḍīnāṃ hṛdayaṃ tadudāhṛtam || 20 ||
anyaśāstrābhiprāyaḥ ||
kaṇṭha rūpātkṣutpipāsā (***)(?) ||
īśatkṛtāpi rasanā bilasūlasaṃsthāpī śa(?)ddvijādharadale vivṛte ca kṛtvā | īśatsudhāra savaraṃ śaśinaśca pītvā tatkṣuttṛṣāṃ maraṇadāharujāṃ nivṛttiḥ || 21 ||
pañcamaṃ binducakraṃ tu trikhaṇḍaṃ vyomagocaram | vyomātītaṃ paraṃśāntamātmarūpaṃ vyavasthitam || 22 ||
bhruvormadhye sthitaṃ cakraṃ bindvākhyaṃ mokṣadāyakam | pañcavarṇadharaṃ devaṃ pañcakālasamāyutam || 23 ||
pañcavelāyutaṃ nityaṃ pañca pañca vivarjitam | niṣprapañcaṃ nirābhāsamaṅguṣṭhaikapramāṇakam || 24 ||
ṣaṣṭhaṃ vai tālu cakraṃ ca devānāmapi durlabham | candrakānti samaprakhyaṃ cintayetkalayā yutam || 25 ||
tatrodāharaṇam |
tālumadhye sthitaṃ cakramamṛtākhya kalāyutam | tatra vai daṇḍapāṇistu saṃsthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 26 ||
aṅgulatrayamānena trikoṇākṛti (***)(?)m | ādvijātyanvyajātyantamekādṛ (*)(?) va rūpiṇī || 27 ||
tasyordhve(?) nāsanaṃ cakraṃ rekhādvāravivarjitam | pramāṇarūparahitaṃ bhāvagamyaṃ sadoditam || 28 ||
yatra sā ca sthitā śaktirvimalā rūpavarjitā | śivena saha caikatra viśrāntiṃ kurute sadā || 29 ||
hakārādūrdhvagā kāryā kālāgninayagāpuraḥ || sā hyeva gulphajānuha sarvādhāre layaṃ gatāḥ || 30 ||
sarvā (*)(?) rātu saṅkoce saṅkocāt turyakoṇake | turyakoṇā tu janmākhye tataḥ skandasya bhāmini || 31 ||
skandāt kuṇḍalinīmadhye kuṇḍalākhyāt ghaṭodare | tadvai sañjīvanasthānaṃ bhūtānāṃ jīvasaṃpuṭe || 32 ||
sañjīvanyāśca kūrme tu kūrmāśca sparśasaṃjñake | sparśāśca lalanāmūle lālākhyāllambake tathā || 33 ||
(**)(?) khyāt guruvaktre ca gururhyajamukhe tathā | itye te ṣodasādhārāssaṃsthitāḥ kulamadhyataḥ || 34 ||
yairbhitvā bāhyataḥ śaktirvajet sapādaśaṃpadam | yā śaktirūhakākhyādhāramadho mārgaṃ gacha(?)tisau (*)(?) kāryā tasyāśca dhārāḥ ṣoḍasa(?)ka (*)(?) nte || (***)(?) nūta (**)(?) rgoḥ sarvādhāre (*)(?) saṃjñite | gudasya kālāgnirudreti paryā(?)yaḥ | asyaiva kāmasaṅkoco vāyuḥ |
yonimārgadvayaṃ vāyoḥ saṅga(?)me sarvadā sthitam | aśaktyā samatāṃ nītvā di(?)vyoyodhaḥ pravartate ||
ta (**)(?) taṃ krośya(?)gudadvāraṃ sarvādhāramaṅguli (*)(?) yasyordhve turyakoṇaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ meḍhre janmākhyaṃ yasmin sthāne strīpuṃsayoḥ saṃyogakāle bījaṃ patitaṃ bhūtvā garbhaḥ sa bhavati janmākhya hāṭakasyā bhya(?)ntare tiryagg(?)tyāṅgula ṣaṭkam | ūrdhvagatyāṅguli dvayam ||
anyaśāstrābhiprāyaḥ ||
jakāre jananaṃ yatra makāre maraṇaṃ bhavet | janmamṛtyu bhaya sthānaṃ janmasthānaṃ tu tadviduḥ ||
meḍhrodhvā(?)ṅgula dvaye janma kandaṃ tasyordhe aṅgula dvayam | tacca trikoṇaṃ nāḍi tritayasyā dhāram | tadyathā nāḍyadho hyaṅgulā dṛ(?)ṣṭau meḍhramūlaṃ tva(?)tadviduḥ | tatra madhye mahācakraṃ kandaṃ nāma prakīrtitam | tālusaṃjñā bhavettasya śodhanaṃ nāmanāmataḥ ||
anya śāstrābhiprāyaḥ ||
nābhi meḍhrāntaraṃ kandaṃ tatvādhāraṃ prakīrtitam | dahantātka (*) madhyasthaṃ caitanyaṃ cittavarjitam | ṣaḍaraṃ prasphurantaṃ ca kandasaṃsthānasaṃsthitam | kulabinduriti khyātaṃ khyātaṃ brahmabilaṃ tathā ||
etat prakṛṣṭakamucyate ||
kuṇḍalinī nābhi deśe ghaṭodaraṃ nābhi hṛtpadmamadhyasthaṃ tasyaiva saṅjīvanīti paryāyaḥ |
nābhi hṛdayapadmasaṃpuṭaṃ madhyam |
kūrmaṃ hṛdayaṃ sarvāṇi padārthāni yatra kūrmāṅgānīvatiṣṭhanti tatkūrmādhāraṃ sarvambaraḥ(?) sthānam |
hṛdayāccaturaṅgulaṃ lolākhyaṃ lolājihvā tasyāmūlaṃ lolāmūlaṃ kaṇṭhasthānam |
lampikādhaḥ ṣaḍaṅgulam |
lambākhyaṃ lambāghaṇṭikāguruvaktraṃ guruvaktreti bindusaṃjñaṃ bhrūmadhyaṃ bhrūmadhyeti bindusaṃjñakaṃ turyasthāne sarveti kathyate |
ajamukhamajamākāśaṃ avidyamānaṃ janmāyasmāttasminsthāne dhvaja(?) iti ||
iti ṣoḍaśādhāram(?) ||
atha trilakṣam ||
antarlakṣaṃ bahirlakṣaṃ lakṣaṃ cobhayavarjitam | bāhyala (*)(?) prayogena pratimādi (*)(?) cālanam |
sarvāvayavasaṃyuktaṃ sarvatantrārthasaṃyutam | śā (***)(?) samāsādya cittacaitanya yogataḥ | parāpravartate dṛṣṭirantarlakṣasya darśanam | bahirantarbahi kṛtvā svasthānasthasya yā sthitiḥ | tallakṣaṃ madhyamaṃ(?) proktaṃ na kiñcidyatra lakṣayet | lakṣa traya vinirmuktaṃ vā (*)(?) yātītamavyayam | sarvā(?)vasthaṃ na sāvasthaṃ paraṃ tallakṣamucyate ||
vyomapañcakamiti ||
prathamaṃ tu brahmavyomaviṣṇuvyoma dvitīyakam | rudravyoma tṛtīyaṃ tu ceśvarākhyaṃ caturthakam | sadāśivaṃ pañcamaṃ tu hyetadvai vyomapañcakam ||
nādyādi hṛdayaṃ yāvadbrahmajñānaṃ viduḥ priye | jāgradvṛtyunubhāvena pārthivaṃ tatvamuttamam || 1 |
hṛdayātkaṇṭhasaṃsthānaṃ viṣṇusthānaṃ prakīrtitam || 2 ||
kaṇṭhā tu yāvadbhrūmadhyaṃ rudrasthānaṃ tu tadviduḥ || 3 ||
suṣuptāvasthayā saṃsthaṃ tejastattvaṃ tu saṃsthitam | bindau tu yāvattalvantamīśvarākhyamanukramam || 4 ||
turyāvasthāśritaṃ jñeyaṃ vāyutatvaṃ samāśritam | tālvantād dvādaśāntaṃ tu sthānaṃ sadāśivaṃ sthitam || 5 ||
turyātītapadāvasthaṃ nabha
(part of the text is missing here)
(**) mi citpatiṃ homaṃ bindunādendu saṃyutam | ṣaṣṭhambā samāyuktaṃ svacchadaṃ vigatā mayam || 3 ||
namaḥ svāhā svadhā vauṣaṭ svavaṣaṭkaṅsamanvitam | dīrghasvarasamāyuktaṃ haṃsaṃ haṃsāṅgabhūṣitam || 4 ||
śaktimantrasamāyuktaṃ parānandapadaṃ sthitam | vyāpinī sahitaṃ devaṃ sṛṣṭikṛdvyāpinīśvaram || 5 ||
ṣaṭtriṃśattattvamadhyasthaṃ paramaṃ mantravigraham | mantrātītaṃ paraṃ śāntamunmanyantaṃ nirāmayam || 6 ||
jyotiṣāṃdhāmadhāmākhyaṃ cidānandaprakāśakam | matijñanaikagamyaṃ tamitareṣāmagocaram || 7 ||
paramātmāpadātītaṃ sa (***)(?) vivarjitam | śivaṃ sarvagataṃ śūnyaṃ sa bāhyābhyantare sthitam || 8 ||
(folio 200 - 239 is missing seemingly due to numbering mistake)
nityoditaṃ mahātejaṃ sūryahaṃsaṃ śivātmakam | rāśicakragataṃ devamayanadvayasaṃsthitam || 9 ||
udare dakṣiṇe candraṃ dakṣiṇo cottaraṃ ravim | pakṣadvayasamāyuktaṃ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitam || 10 ||
yogeśvaraṃ yogagamyaṃ yogātītaṃ nirāmayam | ṣaṭpathaṃ ṣaṭpathātītaṃ śūnyaṃ ṣaṭkasamanvitam || 11 ||
hṛtkuśeśayamadhyasthaṃ grāhyagrāhakagūhitam | ṣaṭpathaṃ ṣaḍabhāvākhyaṃ citpatiṃ cetanātmakam || 12 ||
kharūpaṃ khacaraṃ khasthaṃ khaparaṃ khapatiṃ khagam | kūlā (***)(?) lādhāramakulaṃ kulanā (**)(?) m || 13 ||
sa eva bandhurmātā ca pitā ca sasuhṛt(?)guruḥ | yaṃ sarvasvamiti prāhustaṃ vande parameśvaram || 14 ||
yasya(?) sarvajñatā jñā(?)pti dadhi bodhasvatantratā | a (*****) ktiśca tasmai pūrṇātmane namaḥ || 15 ||
sarvendriya parityāgād vyāptiryasya vilakṣaṇā | ṣāḍguṇyaguṇasaṃyuktā tasmai vyāptātmane namaḥ || 16 ||
jñānādi guṇasaṃyuktaṃ varjitaṃ prākṛtaṃ guṇaiḥ | kṣayotpatti na yasyasthastasmai nityātmane namaḥ || 17 ||
yasya mūlaṃ na cāgraṃ ca na diśo vidiśastathā | na śabdo na tathākāśastasmai śūnyātmane namaḥ || 18 ||
vā(?) paśyatyakṣirahitaḥ svādaṃ bindatya jihvakaḥ | akarṇaḥ śṛṇute yaśca tasmai cittrātmane namaḥ || 19 ||
(**********)| viśvaṃ kāraṇanirhīnastasmai sraṣṭātmane namaḥ || 20 ||
yathā kālo hyasūtropi kurute kāryasādhanam | tathaiva kartā yo nityaṃ tasmaikartrātmane namaḥ || 21 ||
yo nityaṃ vasate dehe viśvamadhye vyavasthitaḥ | sthairya rūpaṃ samāsādya tasmai sthityātmane namaḥ || 22 ||
yasya viśvamidaṃ haṃsarkālamekaṃ bruvantitam | saṃharetkevalātmā ca tasmai kālātmane namaḥ || 23 ||
ya eko bahudhā rūpairvasatyasmiñcarācare | saṃhṛtyedaṃ punaścaikaṃ tasmai māyātmane namaḥ || 24 ||
viśvaṃ jñānakarāgreṇa dhṛtaṃ tattvasamanvitam | līlayā bhrāmyate yena tasmai vīrātmane namaḥ || 25 ||
brahmāṇḍasya yathāmadhye dṛśyate sarṣapā kaṇaḥ | brahmāṇḍaṃ ca tathā yasya tasmai sthūlātmane namaḥ || 26 ||
bālāgra bhāgaḥ śataśaḥ kalpitotha sahasraśaḥ | yasyamānamidaṃ proktaṃ tasmai sūkṣmātmane namaḥ || 27 ||
mahāsthānaṃ śarīre yassarvasatvairadhiṣṭhitaḥ | satvapañjaranirmāṇaṃ tasmai kṣettrātmane namaḥ || 28 ||
kṣettrajño jyotirātmā ca hṛnmadhye tu vyavasthitaḥ | yaḥ śucirnirmalohaṃsastasmai kṣe(?)trātmane namaḥ || 29 ||
maha (*)(?) stamasaḥ pāre unmanyātmānamujjvalam | yaṃ jñātvā na punarjanma tasmai jñānātmane namaḥ || 30 ||
jñānena prāpyate yasmāt kāryaṃ vai kāraṇottaram | yāvatsarvagatā tṛptistasmai jñānātmane namaḥ || 31 ||
dehamadhye sthito yacca nābhicakre paribhraman | citprakāśo hṛdivyāpī tasmaijīvātmane namaḥ || 32 ||
iḍā gaṅgā mahāpuṇyā suṣumṇā yamunā tathā | tayoḥ saṃkrīḍate yaśca tasmaihaṃsātmane namaḥ || 33 ||
yaḥ śuddhaḥ śuklapakṣe tu śuklagaṅgājale sthitaḥ | śuklakarmarato nityaṃ tasmai śuklātmane namaḥ || 34 ||
yaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣe tu saṃsthito yamunā jale | krūrakarmarato nityaṃ(?) tasmai kṛṣṇātmane namaḥ || 35 ||
re(?)cakena vahennityaṃ ṣaḍrasā svādalampaṭaḥ | yastejastapate nityaṃ tasmai sūryātmane namaḥ || 36 ||
pūrake nivasedyaśca niśāyāmamṛtātmakaḥ | āpyāyana karo nityaṃ tasmai somātmane namaḥ || 37 ||
yastṛptastarpayeddevāndevayānenasaṃsthitān | pitṝṇāṃ pitṛsthānena tasmai vahnyātmane namaḥ || 38 ||
sūryasya grahaṇe yaśca viṣuvena ca saṃyutam | iḍāpiṅgalayormadhye saṃlīno hṛdayāntare || 39 ||
yatpuṇyaṃ havyakavyena tasmai tīrthātmane namaḥ || 40 ||
candrodaye candragatyā iḍāṃśe piṅgalārpitam | yaḥ śreyaḥ sarvakāryāṇāṃ tasmai lagnātmane namaḥ || 41 ||
dvādaśānte śubhe kṣettre śivarāhusamanvitam | citsūryagrahaṇaṃ yatra tasmai sthānātmane namaḥ || 42 ||
yatra candro hyapānākhyo yatra cāstaṅgato raviḥ | prāṇāpānakṣayo yatra tasmai mantrātmane namaḥ || 43 ||
brahmārpaṇavidhānena dinarātri parikṣayāt | pūjyate yogibhi yaśca tasmai pūjyātmane namaḥ || 44 ||
svayamuccarate yaśca svadehāvasthitaḥ śivaḥ | dehānte mokṣado yaśca tasmai japyātmane namaḥ || 45 ||
citkṛṣāṇurmano hotā amṛtākhyā parāhṛtiḥ | yatra mantro hakārākhyastasmai hotātmane namaḥ || 46 ||
sarvadevasthito devaḥ saptārciḥ parameśvaraḥ | yaścāntaḥ ṣaḍrasāhārastasmai bhoktātmane namaḥ || 47 ||
yo nityaṃ bhāsayet samyak mayūkhairmahādyutiḥ | sa bāhyābhyantaraṃ sarvaṃ tasmai bhāsātmane namaḥ || 48 ||
yo vyomaparamaṃ brahma citprakāśaṃ nirāmayam | bhūtākāśaṃ parityajya tasmai vyomātmane namaḥ || 49 ||
yovinidrā mahābodhā yuñjānāḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ | paśyanti jyotiṣāṃ jyotistasmai yogātmane namaḥ || 50 ||
pūrake yo bahirbrahmā kumbhake viṣṇureva ca | recake yo vasedrudrastasmai prāṇātmane namaḥ || 51 ||
brahmatve sṛjate viśvaṃ viṣṇutve sthiti kṛścayaḥ | rudratve saṃharatyeva tasmai sthityātmane namaḥ || 52 ||
mātrā pañcakasaṃyuktaṃ prasāde pañcadaivatam | manunātrā yate yena tasmai mantrātmane namaḥ || 53 ||
svayambaścarate yaśca svalpavṛtti halākṛtiḥ | anāhata paraḥ śāntastasmai varṇātmane namaḥ || 54 ||
sragivagrathito yena prākṛto bhumisañcayaḥ | dharmādharma mayaiḥ paśaistasmai vandhātmane namaḥ || 55 ||
sarvādvanapathātīta munmanyate vyavasthitam | sarvākhyeyaṃ paraṃśāntaṃ tasmai mokṣātmane namaḥ || 56 ||
yasya pīṭhamidaṃ viśvaṃ mūrtivyomātmikā bhavet | līyante sarva tatvāni tasmai liṅgātmane namaḥ || 57 ||
unmanyantaṃ paraṃ śuddhaṃ samanāvastu niṣkalam | vyāpinyā sakalaṃ yaśca tasmai muktyātmane namaḥ || 58 ||
calācaleṣu sarveṣu viśvamadhye vyavasthitaḥ | māyāṃbāddhāsthito yaśca tasmai sarvātmane namaḥ || 59 ||
stavarājasamaṃ divyaṃ jñānāñjanamanaśvaram | ajñānatimirāndhasya unmīlanakaraṃ smṛtam || 60 ||
narāṇāṃ kṣīṇapuṇyānāṃ sadyodharmavivardhanam | paraṃ śuddhaṃ pavitraṃ ca sarvaduḥkhanivāraṇam || 61 ||
adhyātmaguṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ jñātvā yaḥ paṭhate naraḥ | sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā sa gacchecchā śvataṃ padam || 62 ||
